findings.title: Route sends traffic to a Service that does not exist
findings.cause: HTTPRoute shop sends traffic to Service storefront-v2 (from rule 1), which does not exist, so the Gateway answers the requests that rule matches with an error (HTTP 500, as the Gateway API requires for a backend it cannot resolve)

evidence.command: kubectl get httproute shop -n kd-gateway-route-service-missing -o jsonpath='{.spec.rules[*].backendRefs}'

evidence.what: there is no Service storefront-v2 in namespace kd-gateway-route-service-missing

findings.fix: Correct the backendRef's name in HTTPRoute shop, or create the Service.
